title: Brickbattle
description: ROBLOX Brickbattling minigame with unique weapons and support for Free-for-All, two-team, and four-team battles
body:
# Brickbattle

Brickbattle is a fast-paced classic combat minigame in ROBLOX.This datapack implements the brickbattle genre in Minecraft.

Choose a game mode from a simple clickable menu and battle with a collection of fun weapons and tools inspired by classic brick-battle games.

## Features

* Free-for-All mode
* Red vs. Blue team battles
* Four-team battles
* A convenient clickable game menu
* Seven unique weapons and tools:
  * Rocket Launcher
  * Slingshot
  * Superball
  * Time Bomb
  * Paintball Gun
  * Trowel
  * Sword
* Automatic scoring, team setup, and match cleanup

## Getting Started

Open the game menu with:
`/function brickbattle:menu`
Select a mode and start fighting!

You can also obtain equipment simply by entering:
`/function brickbattle:give_all`
